external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues who use the identity broker and applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by franchise stores that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates federated sign-ins, and supplies public signing keys.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: Tokens are valid for twelve hours and cannot be pulled back before expiry. Nothing calls back to the broker to check whether a colleague is still allowed in. The broker uses the same signing key for every application. The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that allows holders of a store-manager token to change prices and void transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: The key store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership comes from the HR system overnight, and leavers stop being colleagues through that overnight update.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: The log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying the colleague's staff id and group list.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues sign in through the identity broker using a sign-in vouched for by their own identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

data_flows.name: vouch for sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: pass token
data_flows.description: The identity broker provides a token that the store admin console uses to decide what the holder may do.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.notes: Nothing calls back to the broker to ask whether a colleague is still allowed in.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps the signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleagues and group memberships in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home from which they sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise environment containing franchise colleagues and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
